yon.title: Use yon before a noun
yon.bodyMarkdown:
**yon** means “a” or “an” and comes before the noun:

- **yon liv** — a book
- **yon valiz** — a bag
- **yon machin** — a car

This is the simplest way to introduce one unspecified thing.

definite-after.title: The definite marker comes after the noun
definite-after.bodyMarkdown:
Kreyòl places its singular definite marker **after** the noun:

- **tifi a** — the girl
- **chat la** — the cat
- **pen an** — the bread

The exact form changes with the final sound of the noun. For now, notice the most important structural fact: the marker follows the noun.

contrast.title: yon liv vs. liv la
contrast.bodyMarkdown:
Compare:

- **yon liv** — a book
- **liv la** — the book

The indefinite word comes before the noun; the definite marker comes after it.
